__baseline_prompt__.text: A staged medical-horror photograph of a fictional woman guided by the supplied portrait. Keep its visible facial proportions and short black bob with fine separated fringe as appearance guidance. A clinical encounter has become threatening. She stands in a disused diagnostic room where a wheeled ring-shaped scanner has stopped across the only open doorway. Its white circular aperture frames the unlit corridor, while its narrow patient platform projects toward her, turning a route out into a route into the machine. Her left palm rests flat on the near outer rim at shoulder height; the elbow remains gently bent, and her shoulders turn toward the aperture while her hips and feet remain beside the platform. Her right arm hangs beside her body. She looks through the opening rather than at the camera, brows drawn slightly together and lower lip parted as if she has just understood the obstruction. A pale blue short-sleeved clinical tunic is loosely creased at her waist; the collar leaves a natural line of neck visible. The scanner's indicator strip remains illuminated in the otherwise dim room. The pale inner ring lights one cheek and catches individual strands of her bob; a weak fluorescent fixture fades across scuffed vinyl and an empty wall rail. Show her from head to below the knees from a three-quarter side view, near enough for her face and hand-to-rim contact to read while the ring, projecting platform and doorway remain in the same plane of attention. The ring dominates the right half, her warm skin and dark hair hold the left, and the corridor becomes a dense rectangle inside the machine. Taut quiet, restrained color, realistic clinical plastic, and a cinematic photograph whose alarm comes from the equipment controlling the available space.
